resource: Open container views of one GameSession (domain 14 CONTAINER_VIEWS)
allocation_impact: Canary's 4-bit container id. Each view holds at most 20 entries (GAMEITEM01-CONTAINER-ENTRIES-MAX). A new view while 16 are open is TOO_MANY_VIEWS; a seventeenth view and a view id above 15 fail closed in the codec.
boundary_tests: max=16: sixteen views encode, decode and open
max+1=17: a seventeenth view fails closed both ways, view id 16 fails closed, and a seventeenth OPEN is TOO_MANY_VIEWS
notes: BAGS-0 §5 and §10; tests: container_tree::tests::views_hold_16_views_of_20_entries_and_refuse_more, container_view::tests::a_seventeenth_open_is_too_many_views. Registered by OTV2-20261003-bags-wire-1.
